summary: Frontend-only REGRESSION run at 375x667 for TimeGuard after adding auto-sync (foreground 3-min interval + expo-background-task task in _layout via 'import @/src/lib/backgroundSync'). Objective was to confirm no crash on web/Expo Go where the native TimeguardUsage module is null (usageAvailable=false). System time ~07:28 UTC used for out-of-range window (09:00-10:00). PASS RESULTS: (1) Regression login: padre.test@timeguard.dev / Familia123 lands on ParentDashboard, Landing shows role-parent + role-monitored, no red-screen / no pageerror. The _layout side-effect import of backgroundSync (which calls TaskManager.defineTask on native only, gated by Platform.OS !== 'web') does not break the web boot. (2) Pairing focus: summary-pair -> pairing-generate produced pairing code (UC9YQZ / XBN92Q / Z3AEPA across sub-runs); pairing-close closed the modal correctly. (3) Cross-context join: fresh incognito context -> role-monitored -> join-code -> join-submit (anonymous auth) navigates to MonitoredScreen (monitored-exit visible, no crash). (4) Native fallback (web): testID native-unavailable is rendered with copy 'Se activan al instalar el build de Android (no en Expo Go).' and testID native-panel is NOT rendered. No pageerror observed on monitored context either. (5) request-more: pressing it inserts an extra_time_requests row and monitored-pending appears with 'Solicitud enviada (+30 min)'. (6) Out-of-range schedule: parent -> tab-controles -> device-chip-<latest> -> schedule-label='Fuera-de-rango', schedule-start='09:00', schedule-end='10:00' -> schedule-add. MonitoredScreen realtime-transitions to monitored-locked with title 'Fuera del horario' and copy 'El uso está permitido solo en tus horarios. Próxima franja "Fuera-de-rango" a las 09:00.' request-more-locked visible. (7) monitored-exit-locked (unlink) signs out anon session, clearRole runs, and monitored returns to Landing (role-parent/role-monitored visible) with no errors. registerUsageSync/unregisterUsageSync are no-ops on web (Platform.OS === 'web' short-circuit) so the exit call doesn't throw. No console errors, no React Native red-screen, 0 pageerrors captured across parent + monitored contexts.
action_items: OPTIONAL (cleanup): This run left one extra device row on the parent's family (chips count grew to 3). Not blocking - device rows do not affect functionality; main agent may prune via Supabase REST with the parent token if desired.
critical_code_review_comments: backgroundSync.ts correctly gates TaskManager.defineTask and BackgroundTask.registerTaskAsync/unregisterTaskAsync with Platform.OS !== 'web' AND usageAvailable, so importing the module from _layout.tsx is safe on web (verified: no boot error, MonitoredScreen unaffected).

MonitoredScreen.tsx auto-sync effect (lines 99-106) is guarded by !usageAvailable || !perms.usage, so on web (usageAvailable=false) it returns early without registering the task or starting the 3-minute setInterval - inert as designed.

exit() awaits unregisterUsageSync() before signOut/clearRole - on web this returns immediately (Platform.OS === 'web' guard), so unlink remains fast (~<1s to Landing). No dangling task registration observed.

nativeUsage.ts still uses requireOptionalNativeModule('TimeguardUsage') so native is null on web - usageAvailable=false is stable; the whole native-panel branch (including the new 'Se sincroniza automáticamente cada pocos minutos y en segundo plano' hint) is not rendered on web, matching the review request expectation.
MonitoredScreen.tsx (~230 lines) and ParentDashboard.tsx (~460+ lines) file-size comments from earlier iterations still apply for maintainability - non-blocking.
